title: The Dragon Hatchling
text: A dragon hatchling, no bigger than a dog, has followed the party for a mile, scrabbling over stones and hissing at beetles. Smoke puffs from its nostrils when it sneezes. It is hungry, and it likes you, and somewhere its mother is looking for it.

options.label: Feed the little thing. It is hard to refuse something that likes you so.

outcomes.text: It follows you home, puffing smoke, and the House must build somewhere to keep it. It will not stay little forever.
Its mother finds you, and she is not little, and she is not grateful.

options.label: Drive it away, before its mother comes looking.

outcomes.text: It sulks off, smoking, and sets the brush alight behind the Leader out of spite.

options.label: The shrewdest sells it to a passing collector. Dragons fetch a fine price.

outcomes.text: A fortune, and the collector's carriage rattles off with it squealing inside. Somewhere, its mother will want to know.

options.label: The one with a staff feeds it a spark, curious what it will do.

outcomes.text: It eats the spark and purrs smoke, and rides their shoulder into the next fight, where it is a great help until it gets bored.
It eats the spark and wants more, and takes it.
